page.title: Server Files
page.description: Browse and change the files in each server's game install and Zomboid folders.

readOnlyReasons.permissions: The panel's account can't write here.

unavailable.missing: This folder doesn't exist. Check the path in My Servers.
unavailable.notConfigured: No folder is set for this server. Add it in My Servers.
unavailable.notMounted: The panel's container can't see this folder. Mount it in your Docker setup, then restart the panel.
unavailable.remoteNotActive: Switch to this server to browse its files over SFTP.
unavailable.remoteNotConfigured: Add this server's SFTP login and Server folder in Settings › PanelBridge first.
unavailable.remoteInstallNotSet: Set the remote game install folder to browse it.
unavailable.tooBroad: This is a drive root, a system folder or a home folder, so the file manager won't open it. Point the server at its own folder in My Servers.
unavailable.overlapsPanel: This is inside the panel's own folders, so the file manager won't open it.
unavailable.unreadable: The panel can't read this folder ({{detail}}).
unavailable.sftpUnreachable: The panel can't reach this server over SFTP.

warnings.noInstallMarker: This folder doesn't look like a Project Zomboid server install.
warnings.containerOnly: This folder is inside the panel's container, not mounted from your computer. Changes here are lost when the container is recreated.
warnings.remoteFilesystemRoot: This reaches everything the SFTP login can reach.

running.title: The server is running
running.body: Changes to files it has open take effect after a restart, and replacing files it is using can crash it. World save files are locked until it stops.

unknown.title: Can't tell whether the server is running
unknown.body: Stop the server before changing world save or game files, or confirm each change.

serverState.remoteUnknown: The panel can't see whether this remote server is running.

list.sortLimited: This folder has {{count}} items, so it can only be sorted by name.
list.truncated: This folder has more items than the panel lists. Use Search to find one.
list.linkOutside: This links to somewhere outside this folder, so it can't be opened here.
list.unsupportedName: This name can't be handled safely here. Rename it over SFTP or SSH.

empty.title: This folder is empty
empty.description: Upload a file or create one.

search.placeholder: Search names in this folder and below
search.truncated: The search stopped early. Narrow it down to see everything.

areas.panelData: The panel's own data, hidden to keep accounts and passwords safe.
areas.panelLogs: The panel's logs, including the file manager's own history.
areas.credentials: Login keys for this computer or Steam.
areas.panelBackups: World backups. Download, restore or delete them on the World Backups page.
areas.bridgeIo: PanelBridge's command folder. Only the panel and the game write here.
areas.bridgeManaged: PanelBridge's own file. Change how it's installed in Settings › PanelBridge.
areas.launchScripts: The panel rewrites this startup script before every start. Change memory, ports and passwords in My Servers.

protected.containsProtected: This folder holds something the panel protects, so it can't be moved, renamed or deleted as a whole.

move.hint: Items can only move within this folder.

details.title: {{name}}
details.binary: This file isn't text, so it can't be edited here.

nameRules.dotSegment: “.” and “..” can't be used as names.
nameRules.trailingDotOrSpace: Names can't end with a dot or a space.
nameRules.leadingSpace: Names can't start with a space.
nameRules.bidiControl: Names can't contain invisible text-direction characters.
nameRules.reservedPanelName: The panel uses this name itself.

confirm.title: Are you absolutely sure?
confirm.delete_one: Move {{name}} ({{size}}) from {{folder}} to Trash? The server may stop working if it needs it. You can restore it from Trash for 7 days. Trash doesn't free disk space until it's emptied.
confirm.delete_other: Move {{count}} items ({{files}} files, {{size}}) from {{folder}} to Trash? The server may stop working if it needs them. You can restore them from Trash for 7 days. Trash doesn't free disk space until it's emptied.
confirm.deletePermanent_one: Permanently delete {{name}} ({{size}})? This can't be undone.
confirm.deletePermanent_other: Permanently delete {{count}} items ({{files}} files, {{size}})? This can't be undone.
confirm.trashUnavailable: These can't go to Trash, so deleting them is permanent.
confirm.emptyTrash_one: Permanently delete {{count}} item from Trash? This can't be undone.
confirm.emptyTrash_other: Permanently delete {{count}} items from Trash? This can't be undone.

tokens.serverRunning: The server is running. It won't see this change until it restarts, and replacing a file it is using can crash it.
tokens.serverStateUnknown: The panel can't confirm the server is stopped. Only continue if you know it is.
tokens.overwrite: {{names}} already exists. The current version will be moved to Trash.
tokens.executable: {{names}} runs as code when the server starts. Only upload files you trust.
tokens.permanent: This deletes the files for good.

confirm.mixedEol: This file mixes line-ending styles. Saving will use one style for the whole file.
confirm.saveAnywayTitle: Replace the newer version on disk?
confirm.saveAnywayBody: Your text replaces what's on disk now. The version on disk goes to Trash.

editor.tailView: Showing the last {{size}} of this file.
editor.escHint: Press Esc, then Tab, to leave the editor.

conflict.title: This file changed on disk
conflict.description: Someone or something changed it after you opened it. Reload to see the new version, copy your text first, or save yours anyway.

versions.title: Previous versions
versions.loaded: Loaded the version from {{when}}. Save to restore it.

hints.restartToApply: The server reads this file when it starts. Restart it to apply your change.
hints.panelRewritesKeys: The panel rewrites RCONPassword and RCONPort in this file before every start. Change them in My Servers instead.
hints.luaChecksum: Changing game Lua files makes them differ from players' copies. With DoLuaChecksum=true, players won't be able to join.
hints.steamUpdateOverwrites: Steam updates and file verification replace game files changed here.
hints.bridgeWorkshopEntries: Keep ZCPB in Mods= and its item in WorkshopItems=. The panel puts them back at the next start.
hints.secretsMasked: Passwords in this file are hidden. Leave the ••• values as they are to keep them; type a new value to change one.

upload.dropHere: Drop files or folders to upload into {{folder}}
upload.tooMany: Upload at most {{limit}} files at once.
upload.paused: Paused by the rate limit, resuming in {{seconds}} s

download.large: Large download. Keep this tab open until it finishes.
download.interrupted: The download was interrupted. Try again.
download.masked: Passwords in .ini files are hidden in downloads.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted, replaced and earlier versions of files stay here for 7 days, then the panel removes them. They still use disk space until then.

remote.title: Remote folders
remote.description: Folders on the remote server that the file manager can open over SFTP.
remote.installHelp: The folder that holds ProjectZomboid64.json or start-server.sh, for example /home/pz/pzserver.
remote.rootWarning: “/” gives access to everything the SFTP login can reach.
remote.needsBridgeSetup: Only someone who can set up PanelBridge can change these folders.

access.denied: Your role doesn't include Manage server files. Ask an admin.
access.authDisabled: The file manager only works while panel logins are on.
